title: H2 response campaign sample manifest (mass-ready receiver contract)
description: Versioned input manifest for future H2 response campaigns (including masses beyond the validated 130/150/170 GeV grid). This schema defines the RECEIVER contract only: it does not change, optimize, or implement any analysis or physics behavior. ctau_response_mm and ctau_physical_mm are intentionally separate fields and must never be silently equated -- see field descriptions.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for this generated sample (e.g. h2_mH300_ctauresp10mm_s81001).

parent_model_point_id.description: Identifier of the physical model point (mass spectrum + coupling configuration) this sample belongs to. Multiple samples (different seeds, different ctau_response_mm scan points) can share one parent_model_point_id.

model_variant.description: Production/decay model-generation variant. This is a PHYSICS GENERATION axis, distinct from any recast analysis-mode label (e.g. 'ORIGINAL_PUBLISHED_TRACKLESS' used elsewhere in this release for the recast selection). At minimum, FACTORIZED_G_ONLY and PHYSICAL_DECAYS_NO_HEAVY_CASCADES must be accepted; additional variants may be added later without breaking this schema.

m_h_GeV.description: SM-like Higgs mass input [GeV]. Fixed at 125 GeV in current benchmarks but recorded explicitly for future non-degenerate points.

m_H2_GeV.description: Heavy scalar H2 mass [GeV] -- the primary LLP mass axis this schema is being extended to cover at higher values.

m_A_GeV.description: Pseudoscalar A mass [GeV], null if not present/relevant in this model point.

m_Hp_GeV.description: Charged scalar H+ mass [GeV], null if not present/relevant in this model point.

ctau_response_mm.description: Lifetime [mm] used to configure the DETECTOR-RESPONSE scan (Recast:llpTau0 in the recast card). A factorized detector-response scan may vary this independently of any physical model width. MUST NOT be silently equated with ctau_physical_mm.

ctau_physical_mm.description: Lifetime [mm] derived from the physical model point's total decay width (c*hbar/Gamma_total). Used for physical-model studies. MUST NOT be silently equated with ctau_response_mm -- a physical-model study must use this field, not the response-scan value, unless the two are demonstrably identical for that sample and that equality is recorded explicitly downstream.

decay_sampling_mode.description: How the LLP decay is sampled in generation, e.g. 'forced_bb', 'physical_BR_inclusive', 'forced_single_channel'.

forced_decay_channel.description: If decay_sampling_mode forces a single channel (e.g. H2->bb as in the current canonical benchmark), the channel label; null if the sample uses inclusive/physical branching.

physical_BR.description: Physical branching ratio for forced_decay_channel (if any), to be applied downstream exactly once. Null if not applicable (inclusive sampling).

production_process.description: MadGraph production process string, e.g. 'g g > H > h2 h2'.

sigma_fb.description: Production cross section [fb] at the generator level for production_process.

lhe_sha256.description: sha256 of the (uncompressed, physics-content) LHE event file.

card_sha256.description: sha256 of the Pythia .cmnd run card used for this sample.

ufo_sha256.description: sha256 of the UFO model archive used to generate this sample.

seed.description: Random seed used for this run.

N_events.description: Number of events generated/processed in this sample.
